mapper.insert: insert into media_recent (owner_key, kind, target_id, album_id, seq, pos, dur) select #{ownerKey}, #{kind}, #{targetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{albumId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{seq,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{pos,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{dur,jdbcType=DECIMAL} from dual where not exists (select 1 from media_recent where )
mapper.update: update media_recent set pos = #{pos,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, dur = #{dur,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, updated_at = current_timestamp(3) where
mapper.select: select r.kind, r.target_id, r.album_id, r.seq, r.pos, r.dur, r.updated_at as happened_at, coalesce(v.title, a.title) as title from media_recent r left join media_video v on r.kind = 'video' and v.id = r.target_id left join media_album a on r.kind = 'photo' and a.id = r.album_id where r.owner_key = #{ownerKey} and r.kind = #{kind} order by r.updated_at desc, r.id desc limit #{limit}
select count(*) from media_recent where owner_key = #{ownerKey} and kind = #{kind}
mapper.delete: delete from media_recent where owner_key = #{ownerKey} and kind = #{kind} and id not in (select id from ( select id from media_recent where owner_key = #{ownerKey} and kind = #{kind} order by updated_at desc, id desc limit #{keep}) k)
